
declare namespace tools {
  /**
   * Exact indexed path search (<0.1ms). Name, glob, extension or git-status filter; `near` re-ranks by proximity; worktree unless global.
   */
  function ultrasearch_query(args: {
    /** Name, glob, or filter (e.g. 'git:modified', 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx} !test/') */
    query: string;
    /** Max results (default 30) */
    limit?: number;
    /** Whole disk instead of the worktree */
    global?: boolean;
    /** Re-rank by folder proximity to this path */
    near?: string;
    /** Deadline (ms); partial results set complete:false */
    budget_ms?: number;
    /** Append match-reason tags (default true) */
    explain?: boolean;
  }): Promise<{
    matches: Array<{
      path: string;
      relPath: string;
      kind: "file" | "dir" | "link";
      score: number;
      git?: string;
    }>;
    took_us: number;
  }>;

  /**
   * Indexed content search (<1ms) with compact 'file:line: match' output; credentials are DLP-scrubbed.
   */
  function ultrasearch_grep(args: {
    /** Text or identifier to search */
    pattern: string;
    /** Subfolder or file filter */
    path_filter?: string;
    /** Read one file directly (JSON, lockfiles, logs) */
    file?: string;
    /** Case handling (default smart) */
    case?: "smart" | "sensitive" | "insensitive";
    /** Whole disk instead of the current scope */
    global?: boolean;
    /** literal (default) | regex | symbol (defs first) | semantic (EXPERIMENTAL: nDCG 0.194, paraphrase recall 0.175, FP 1.00 — do not gate on it) */
    mode?: "literal" | "regex" | "symbol" | "semantic";
    /** Max files (default 30) */
    limit?: number;
    /** One-line 'file:line: match' (default true) */
    compact?: boolean;
    /** Output token budget */
    max_tokens?: number;
    /** Context lines per match (0-5, default 0) */
    context?: number;
    /** Tag AST definitions ([def:fn], [def:class]) */
    tag_symbols?: boolean;
    /** Deadline (ms); partial results set complete:false */
    budget_ms?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    files: Array<{
      path: string;
      matches: Array<{ line: number; text: string }>;
    }>;
    took_us: number;
  }>;

  /**
   * OR-search several patterns in one indexed call.
   */
  function ultrasearch_multi_grep(args: {
    /** Patterns to OR */
    patterns: string[];
    /** Subfolder filter */
    path_filter?: string;
    /** Max files (default 30) */
    limit?: number;
    /** One-line 'file:line: match' (default true) */
    compact?: boolean;
    /** Output token budget */
    max_tokens?: number;
    /** Deadline (ms); partial results set complete:false */
    budget_ms?: number;
  }): Promise<{
    files: Array<{
      path: string;
      matches: Array<{ line: number; text: string }>;
    }>;
    took_us: number;
  }>;

  /**
   * Exact filename lookup in the workspace (O(1) indexed).
   */
  function ultrasearch_locate(args: {
    /** Exact filename (e.g. 'package.json') */
    filename: string;
    /** Whole disk */
    global?: boolean;
  }): Promise<{ content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }> }>;

  /**
   * Recently edited workspace files, frecency-ranked.
   */
  function ultrasearch_recent(args?: {
    /** Max files (default 15) */
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<{ content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }> }>;

  /**
   * Toolchain metrics: latency percentiles, error and zero-hit rates, tuning advice. Defaults to organic rows (gate/bench runs excluded).
   */
  function ultrasearch_metrics(args?: {
    /** Provenance view (default real = organic only) */
    view?: "real" | "synthetic" | "all";
    /** Rows to analyze (default 1000) */
    limit?: number;
  }): Promise<{ content: Array<{ type: "text"; text: string }> }>;
}
